changed.explanation: Every new production event is provider.status_changed, written by the RUNNING production Host itself (its periodic provider probe). It records which model the shared local Ollama service has loaded; T10's disposable live tests loaded and unloaded huihui_ai/qwen2.5-abliterate:7b there, and Ollama had one offline/online blip. The providers table and sqlite_sequence change with those probe records. T10 never wrote production state; its database was only opened read-only.

audioEndpointsSha256.explanation: The PnP AudioEndpoint list hash (InstanceId|Status|FriendlyName) differs. Current endpoints: Speakers (SD4780P Audio) status Unknown (external display/dock audio, currently disconnected); Speakers (Realtek(R) Audio) OK; Microphone Array (Intel Smart Sound) OK. A device presence change from docking is outside T10. T10 never installs or modifies drivers or audio settings (the worker reads Core Audio only). Endpoint mute is not part of this hash; the user unmuted the microphone themselves.
